0.name: L
0.text: Do you ever think about how your actions have consequences?

2.name: L
2.text: Sorry, just something my friend talked to me about.

3.name: L
3.text: It’s weird, huh? How people have so much effect on each other.

5.name: L
5.text: Is it subconscious, or do we let it happen?

6.name: L
6.text: Maybe we feel the need to be affected and steered by something else...

7.name: L
7.text: ...Because we’re too weak to change things ourselves?

8.name: L
8.text: Because we need any push, any reason, any blow of the wind to start what we should have done a long time ago.

9.name: L
9.text: We don’t realize the bad things until they take root and grow.

12.name: L
12.text: And grow, right into our hearts. And into our brains.

13.name: L
13.text: But that’s boring talk! I don’t like it!

14.name: L
14.text: I’ll stay with my Hello Puppy plushies and my candies, thank you :3

18.name: L
18.text: I was curious, are you still taking those online classes? You know, for that college?

22.name: L
22.text: Don’t you think that’s kind of a waste of time?

24.name: L
24.text: It’s just that none of my friends who went to college are actually doing very well these days.

25.name: L
25.text: They spent all that time studying and working hard, but it wasn’t worth it at the end.

26.name: L
26.text: They regretted all the time they could have spent working and making friends.

27.name: L
27.text: I think that sounds really bad.

30.name: L
30.text: I’ll support you no matter what you choose to do, okay?

31.name: L
31.text: I’m sure you know what you’re doing very well!
